create_wavegrad_model: create a WaveGrad diffusion model instance with a config object for speech synthesis
set_noise_schedule: set a variable noise schedule on a WaveGrad model with custom steps and noise bounds
sample_speech_waveform: sample a speech waveform from mel-spectrogram inputs via progressive denoising
compute_training_loss: compute the L1 loss between ground-truth noise and reconstructed noise for training
generate_speech_forward: generate speech from a mel-spectrogram tensor using the WaveGrad forward method
